system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Medicine and Survival, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Herbalism Lore, Foraging Lore, Lore of a wilderness region.
system.description: You lived far from ready help and learned to find shelter and tend injuries with what the country provided. Returning to company has given you fresh reasons to value the habits of solitude.
